1  critical  A departed person or retired account retains access (production)
   [identity.former_person_has_access]
   Subject       former (account former)
   You declared  engagement.yaml people.pat.left: Operator declaration at people.pat.left
   Observed      collaborators (12:00, as alice (user ID 41)): former permissions.admin=true
   Concluded from request:collaborators, declared:people.pat.left
   Severity      critical: base high, +1 attribute admin (collaborators: former
                 permissions.admin=true)
   Why here      Pat left on 2026-09-01 and still administers the production repository.
   Fix           Remove its memberships and repository access, and review credentials and sessions.

2  high  An outside collaborator administers a production repository (production)
   [github.outside_admin_on_production]
   Subject       external (account external)
   You declared  engagement.yaml assets.production.context.deploys_to: Operator declaration at
                 assets.production.context.deploys_to
   Observed      outside (12:00, as alice (user ID 41)): external permissions.admin=true
   Observed      collaborators (12:00, as alice (user ID 41)): external permissions.admin=true
   Concluded from request:outside, request:collaborators,
                  declared:assets.production.context.deploys_to
   Severity      high
   Why here      The repository deploys to production and external has effective administrative
                 permission.
   Fix           Confirm the administrative need and reduce repository permissions where possible.

3  high  The organization does not require two-factor authentication (engineering)
   [github.mfa_not_required]
   Observed      organization (12:00, as alice (user ID 41)): two_factor_requirement_enabled=false
   Severity      high
   Why here      This is the standard rating for the observed access or settings.
   Fix           Enable GitHub's organization two-factor requirement after checking users and
                 automation; SAML or identity-provider MFA does not replace this GitHub control.

4  high  An organization owner has no two-factor authentication (engineering)
   [github.owner_without_mfa]
   Subject       alex (account alex)
   Observed      owners-no-mfa (12:00, as alice (user ID 41)): owner alex appears in the provider's
                 2fa_disabled owner list
   Severity      high
   Why here      This is the standard rating for the observed access or settings.
   Fix           Enable strong GitHub two-factor authentication for this account, preferably
                 security keys; check it even when SAML sign-in uses MFA.

5  high  An owner is not among the declared expected owners (engineering)
   [identity.unexpected_admin]
   Subject       unexpected (account unexpected)
   You declared  engagement.yaml identity.expected_owners: Operator declaration at
                 identity.expected_owners
   Observed      owners (12:00, as alice (user ID 41)): owner unexpected
   Concluded from request:owners, declared:identity.expected_owners
   Severity      high: base medium, +1 contradiction (identity.expected_owners)
   Why here      The expected owners declaration names Alex; unexpected was also observed as an
                 owner.
   Fix           Confirm whether the person needs owner access; remove it or correct the expected
                 owner declaration.

6  high  A repository is public without a public declaration (production)
   [github.undeclared_public_repository]
   Subject       example-org/production (repository example-org/production)
   Observed      repository (12:00, as alice (user ID 41)): visibility=public
   Severity      high
   Why here      This is the standard rating for the observed access or settings.
   Fix           Confirm public visibility is intentional and declare public: true, or change the
                 repository visibility.

7  high  A deploy key can write to the repository (production) [github.writable_deploy_key]
   Subject       deploy key 9 (deploy_key deploy-key:9)
   You declared  engagement.yaml assets.production.context: Operator declaration at
                 assets.production.context
   Observed      keys (12:00, as alice (user ID 41)): deploy key 9 read_only=false
   Concluded from request:keys, declared:assets.production.context
   Severity      high: base medium, +1 deploys to production (assets.production.context.deploys_to)
   Why here      This repository deploys to production.
   Fix           Replace the key with a read-only deploy key or a narrowly scoped application
                 credential.

8  medium  Organization members receive broad default repository access (engineering)
   [github.broad_default_member_permission]
   Observed      organization (12:00, as alice (user ID 41)): default_repository_permission=write
   Severity      medium
   Why here      This is the standard rating for the observed access or settings.
   Fix           Set a narrow base permission and grant repository access through specific teams.

9  medium  The organization has more owners than its size needs (engineering)
   [github.too_many_owners]
   Observed      owners (12:00, as alice (user ID 41)): observed owners=5 members=6
   Observed      members (12:00, as alice (user ID 41)): observed owners=5 members=6
   Severity      medium
   Why here      This is the standard rating for the observed access or settings.
   Fix           Reduce owner privileges to the people who need them while retaining at least two
                 recovery-capable owners.
